spells.procedure:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, one creature, 10d6 cold and CON success negating ALL effects. NEW select one perceived creature with line of effect, regardless of willingness; there is no voluntary save waiver. Success deals no damage and establishes no suspension. Failure first resolves 10d6 cold using the ordinary packet, survival and body rules. If the same target remains a living or otherwise active creature and the caster's combined source-character/target/encounter whole-Action denial allowance is available, attempt the following new temporal suspension. The guard is spent only when that suspension is actually established. A relevant complete protection against temporal suspension or whole-Action denial prevents it; cold immunity alone does not. An unavailable guard leaves failed-save cold damage intact, with no soft fallback or delayed claim.

NEW the control is genuine finite local suspension, not the Core Frozen or Petrified condition. It requires the caster's concentration from cast commitment and lasts until the caster's next future original regular START, or six elapsed seconds outside initiative, whichever applicable original clock was established. If no suspension is established, this cast leaves no ongoing concentration burden. The suspended creature is unaware, cannot speak, act, take Bonus Actions/Reactions, make voluntary choices or move, and its body and actually carried equipment are held at their current location and pose. Voluntary and forced relocation, including ordinary teleportation, cannot move that held body; a source expressly overcoming temporal suspension retains its stated exception. No ordinary STR/DEX failure or attack-advantage rule is inferred from Incapacitated, because this is its own action-denial state, not a newly applied Incapacitated condition.

During operative suspension, the held body cannot receive new damage, healing, temporary HP, conditions or physical alterations. Attempts otherwise legal to target it spend their actual costs but have no bodily payload and store nothing. Existing periodic bodily outputs due during the interval are skipped, not banked. Death saves are likewise not rolled while suspended and create no success or failure. The body's age and immediate respiration/metabolic activity pause for this finite interval; it gains no food, water, rest credit or completed work. World time, existing absolute deadlines, source/recipient regular markers, spell expiry, actual rest calendars and resource-use history continue. The marker still occurs even when its body cannot act; this is not a new initiative slot. Existing concentration held by the target remains unless its own actual deadline, unpaid upkeep or independent ending ends it; suspension alone does not inflict ordinary Incapacitated or restore ended concentration. A required voluntary upkeep that cannot be paid fails by its original rule.

The suspension itself remains a reachable ongoing rank-six magical effect for specifically legal dispel/suppression/removal, even though the protected body cannot take a new bodily payload. A protection that only stops fire or poison does not defeat this state. The caster may release concentration normally. On expiry, ending or suppression, bodily interaction resumes at the current real location with no backlog, fresh turn, restored spent Action, resource reset or returned missed tick. Only still-unspent permissions in an actual current turn may be used. If suppression ends before the original deadline, the same still-live suspension resumes around the surviving creature at its then-current position, without snapping it back or spending the guard again. It cannot resume on a dead/removed identity. Simultaneous suspensions do not add duration or borrow another instance's clock; a body already protected from a new bodily payload cannot acquire a new suspension through it. After support ends, genuine unsupported height uses the ordinary Fall Marker. Gear remains the same real inventory, inaccessible while held; no detachable ice, time travel, stored-damage burst, reset disease duration or implemented Time Loop restoration is created.

TC124-AZ-01 DIRECTOR COMPLETION (NEW locally except expressly inherited rules). The base price is 13 RP on the actual selected access route. The endpoint is selected at successful establishment: the caster's next original regular START strictly after establishment, or establishment+6 seconds when established outside initiative; ordinary Ready is still paid at preparation and the endpoint starts at release/establishment, not preparation. A source marker already underway is not made future. The cold packet has the actual original caster's ordinary damage-root provenance. Resolve complete defenses, sharing, zero/death/Wounds and damage-concentration consequences before attempting suspension. A transferred branch cannot acquire the rider. A living Dying/Stable creature can be suspended if it survives the packet and the source/target hard guard permits; immunity to cold is not immunity to suspension.
While operative, direct HP expenditure through a voluntary activation is not payable; involuntary direct HP losses, healing, temp HP and physical condition admissions to the body are prevented as bodily outputs. Nonbodily source endings, deadlines, private ownership/spent histories and actual explicitly world-timed lethal tracks are not prevented. True death from an independently specified world-timed cause ends this suspension and its concentration; it is not stored for later. This does not invent such a lethal track.
Use the same body-emitted-output boundary as selected Chrono Lock: no body aura output, new speech, personal command or further personal cast requirement while held. Independent established external fields keep their own controllers, deadlines and exact concentration requirements. Suspension does not itself impose ordinary Incapacitated or erase consciousness flags belonging to another cause. Real mandatory form endings and concentration/source termination still occur as source transitions; they do not duplicate the old body or equipment. The held pose remains, with legal support/placement reconciled on release under the actual body source, without remote eviction.
Stable recovery is not an expended periodic damage tick: preserve its actual already-rolled absolute deadline. If due while this suspension blocks its 1HP, retain an overdue pending-state receipt and do not reroll the d4, restart time or heal through protection. When the block actually ends, resolve that same due state recovery once if legal under the accepted regular-start/changed-blocker ordering; any independent HP-gain blocker still applies. No omitted death save or missed periodic damage is replayed. Actual END events resolve before END-bound cleanup; this source's START-bound ending resolves before the caster's mandatory START processing. Round identity and source-owned recharge/caps are not rewritten. Externally supplied temporal-remove/immune permissions must be real; none is created merely by writing that a callback exists.

KEEP both actual placements: Divination freezes exactly one creature in time for one round with no save; Universal grants no Actions or damage for one round. NEW harmonize them into the following full local suspension, with no save in either mode and damage protection in both. This expressly extends the Divination wording with the Universal clause; the original two entries remain distinct evidence and the selected class still determines the generating school. This is not a selectable bargain between a vulnerable and an invulnerable mode. One perceived living or otherwise active creature within60feet/line of effect, including self; an inanimate corpse or detached object is not a creature target. NEW no concentration, lasting to the target's first future regular END, or the original outside-initiative six-second endpoint. It is not ordinary Frozen, Petrified, Stunned or Incapacitated.

Apply the shared source-character/target/encounter hard-denial admission even when the recipient is willing, an explicit NEW conservation choice. Actual immunity to temporal suspension or equivalent whole-Action denial prevents admission. No save is silently introduced to replace the source's express no-save clause. A used allowance or actual protection produces no suspension or protective fallback and no delayed attempt; legal committed casting costs remain spent. Spend the allowance only on actual establishment. Neither ending nor suppression refunds that history. A target already under operative full bodily suspension cannot receive another bodily application through it; a genuinely suppressed old suspension may allow a different source's legal attempt, without extending either original endpoint.

While operative, the target is unaware and cannot speak, act, take Bonus Actions/Reactions, make voluntary choices or move. Hold its actual body and actually worn/carried inanimate gear at the current place and pose. Voluntary/forced relocation, ordinary teleportation and gravity cannot move that held body; an actual explicit source overcoming temporal suspension retains only its printed exception. Carried or mounted other creatures are not frozen by association: ordinary custody/support and separation rules determine their legal positions, and the target cannot carry them away because it cannot move. Gear cannot be detached, used or looted through the held body. Do not infer automatic STR/DEX failure, attack advantage, adjacent criticals or prone from a different condition's name.

The suspended body and its held gear receive no new damage, healing, temporaryHP, condition, directHP loss or physical alteration. Otherwise legal attempts pay their real costs and resolve no such payload; incoming damage is prevented, never accumulated for release. No resource can be paid through the body's unavailable voluntary action. Existing periodic bodily outputs due while held are skipped, not banked; death saves create neither successes nor failures. Age, immediate respiration and metabolism pause for the interval, but no food, water, completed work or rest credit is supplied. World elapsed time, actual regular markers, rest/shortage calendars, recharge history and existing effect deadlines continue. A due lethal world-track transition is recorded under its real source; suspension does not erase or defer that source's explicitly world-timed death rule. An effect that ends while held stays ended.

Existing concentration is not ended solely by this distinct non-Incapacitated state. Its ordinary expiry, actual unpaid voluntary upkeep, dependent source ending or genuine independent concentration-ending rule still applies. Already independent external spell fields, completed projectiles and other bodies keep their own legal behavior and do not become frozen. NEW body-emitted class/spell aura output and voluntary command/control operation are unavailable while the source body is held; the underlying source clock continues, and missed outputs/orders do not replay. A pending paid activation requiring further personal action cannot complete that requirement; a fully committed independent effect may still resolve under its own actual dependency rules. No cost is refunded.

The Chrono Lock application itself remains reachable for actual eligible rank-six dispel, suppression or specific removal, despite the body's payload protection. NEW the originating caster may dismiss its own application without an Action during its actual turn only while able to act; a self-locked caster cannot use dismissal while suspended. Ending or suppression restores ordinary interaction at the current real location, with no backlog, free turn, fresh movement or restored Action. Only actual unspent permissions of a still-current turn remain. When suppression ceases before the original deadline, the same live application resumes around its surviving eligible creature at its then-current position; it cannot snap back to its old position or restart the round. Death/removal of that creature ends its application. Unsupported height after suspension uses the real Fall Marker; physical gear, broken support and real elapsed consequences remain. This finite state supplies no world rewind, snapshot restoration or implementation approval for the temporal kernel.

TC124-CL-01 DIRECTOR COMPLETION. Select the complete proposed harmonization as NEW source-local authorship; its 13RP price and six actual class/school routes remain unchanged. Freeze eligibility and the hard-control claim are checked at resolution. The target's first future regular END means the END of its first regular turn starting strictly after establishment; exclude an already-underway target turn. Outside initiative use establishment+6 seconds and do not reset it on initiative entry. A source neither grants a fresh target phase nor takes the timing of an unprovided companion profile: a target without an independently established regular/owner cadence requires that actual cadence or the genuine outside-initiative clock.
As with Absolute Zero, retain a due blocked Stable-recovery state deadline, not a spent/rearmed d4 timer. Resolve its one already-due recovery once when the block ends and it is legally processed; if another blocker remains, keep the same pending deadline. Periodic bodily damage opportunities and ordinary death saves blocked by operative suspension are skipped without dice, counters or backlog. Exact independently world-timed lethal tracks and source endings still run; true death ends this application before any resumption.
Neither held gear nor a carried other creature is duplicated or given an extra suspension. An actually current held creature can use only the real remaining budget after suppression; an already-ended turn is not reopened. Own regular START refreshes ordinary ledgers under their source despite unavailable voluntary behavior; extra turns do not refresh them. On END-bound expiry, all genuine END consequences occur while the application is operative, then it ends. The originator's free own-turn dismissal is specifically selected NEW, requires actual ability to act, and cannot be used by a self-locked caster. An absent application is never inferred merely because a corpse, frozen silhouette or former location exists.

KEEP Bonus Action, V/S/F and skipping the next round before reappearing with a surprise Bonus Action. NEW self only; the original sixty-foot target metadata remains preserved as an unassigned alternative, not permission to remove another creature. Cast on your actual regular turn to arm one departure at your next future original regular START; you remain normally present for the rest of the casting turn. Outside initiative arm for +6 elapsed seconds, followed by a six-second absence. At the departure checkpoint, after actual start-ending expirations and before refresh/voluntary opportunities, recheck your continuing identity and any exact source preventing this temporal absence. If prevented or the armed effect is suppressed, it ends without departure or bonus; costs remain spent. A dead/ended creature cannot newly depart. NEW departure ends your current concentration and removes only your body and actually lawful noncreature gear from ordinary local occupancy/targeting for one original regular-turn interval, returning at the following original regular START or six elapsed seconds after outside departure. Carried creatures, a mount and grapplers stay with their own actual support/relationships. Record the exact departure anchor, original body/cargo identities and return marker; invent no destination plane or rewind. While absent you take no Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, voluntary movement, item interactions, commands or speech and gain no new observations of the scene. No fresh external attack/area/target selection can select the absent body at its old position. Already attached effects and their actual elapsed deadlines continue: periodic damage, saves, death/life recovery and explicitly automatic source events follow their own genuine predicates, but no new caster/companion operation or resource-generating opportunity is created by a virtual skipped turn. Suppressed/ineligible due events are lost, never banked. At the skipped regular marker do not refresh Reaction or action/movement budgets; advance actual duration/recharge clocks and process required life-state bookkeeping, without treating absence as rest or a new Time Loop iteration. The regular turn being skipped supplies no optional activity. Any genuine already committed consequence remains committed; departure does not refund, copy or rewind it. At the return marker the absence ends before ordinary return-turn processing. Try the actual departure space, legal squeeze, then the existing nearest-adjacent placement procedure in the same unobstructed region, minimum displacement/greatest prior overlap/fixed neutral tie order. No farther safe-space search, barrier passage or crushing damage is added. If no legal adjacent placement exists, record the same body at its actual return anchor with a placement conflict under the current body rules; this is a returned body, not extended invulnerability or a continued absence. Actual anchor cover/targetability and ongoing life consequences apply, while movement/physical actions require resolution of their genuine geometry. The return does not change items or create another body. NEW after mandatory regular-start processing, a living eligible returning caster receives one additional Bonus Action opportunity, usable immediately for one genuinely available Bonus-Action feature/spell with all ordinary costs, then lost if declined/ineligible. Its scope excludes Time Skip itself and abilities whose effect is to grant another action/turn; it creates no Surprise condition, advantage or special attack. The ordinary return-turn Bonus Action remains separately available, but no other round cap or companion command/offense allowance refreshes from this extra opportunity. Only one Time Skip return-bonus per character/numbered round; it cannot be copied or banked. If return is outside initiative, offer that one immediate Bonus Action under actual downtime legality; a hostile action first enters normal initiative without ambush actions before that process. Actual death during absence does not delete the body: return its same remains at the marker, with no bonus or restored resources. Qualifying removal/full suppression during absence forces early return using the same placement procedure and grants no bonus; removing the armed effect cancels departure. Recast cannot replace an armed/absent instance, and neither departure nor return supplies a new turn beyond the already scheduled return turn.

TC124-TS-01 DIRECTOR SELECTION. The Self-only operational recipient is a substantive NEW restriction/completion of the unassigned Core60ft, not inherited metadata or an allied removal power. Base7RP; Bonus Action; preserve all seven actual class routes and V/S/F. Choose this self mode and full body/gear custody at paid commitment; a known preexisting armed/absent instance makes a recast illegal before payment. On a genuine own regular turn, arm next original regular START for departure and its following START for return. An initiative change preserves those already recorded markers; no unused turn is stored. Outside origin uses +6 departure/+12 return.
At departure, expire START-ending sources first, then recheck life/eligibility and actual source suppression, terminate the caster's incompatible concentration as selected, and take the actual lawful noncreature inventory snapshot. Dropped objects, carried other creatures and mounts stay in the world. Process mandatory already-due state recovery, death saves and automatic source events at the skipped marker using the same identity; do not offer optional actions, command, recharge use or budget refresh. Source-specific recharge time may advance without supplying an action. An already attached native effect whose source does not require continuing local perception/contact can still deliver its genuine due packet/save to that identity. This explicitly supplies the recipient route for the accepted Leeching Plague schedule; its actual life eligibility, end-on-target-death, no-recovery branches and donor filters remain. Plague is necrotic, not an invented poison; the old unnamed poison example remains a separately qualified obligation.
No new local creature or aura remains at the anchor. A Greater Dispel or Antimagic sphere at that empty location has no automatic route to the absent application. Early removal requires an independently supplied exact source capable of addressing that actual application during absence. No such removal source is invented by this procedure; the logical response if one genuinely exists is early same-body return without the extra BA.
At scheduled return, end absence, attempt the real anchor/squeeze/nearest-adjacent placement within the actual unobstructed region, and record unresolved placement conflict rather than prolonged absence. Process the entire actual START: expirations, real budget/reaction refresh and recharge, due Stable recovery, death save, then other mandatory START sources in their established order. Only after those, if alive and actually able to activate the chosen BA with legal current geometry/components/costs, offer one immediately spent-or-lost extra BA. This bonus cannot recast Time Skip, create another extra-BA/Action/turn/automatic-cast engine, reset a use, or complete an opportunity after a mandatory lethal event. A declined/blocked bonus is marked settled, not banked. Ordinary BA remains separate; source-specific frequency/command caps continue to apply across both. The real numbered-round ID, not floor(timestamp/6), keys the one return-bonus receipt. A death or incapacitating mandatory START result prevents bonus activation. A dead identity returns as its same real remains, carrying only its actual surviving associated gear.

KEEP Action,10RP and casting TWO spells of LEVEL3ORLOWER in one turn. NEW interpret level as each child's actual selected-class Resonance Rank0through3, not character level,discounted price or an unrelated catalog placement. NEW operational recipient is Self and the recorded Core60-foot field supplies no ally grant; retain that original range as an explicit design conflict for review. The Quicken casting Action,if it resolves on the caster's own current turn, contains one immediate finite window in which the caster may actually cast the two declared eligible spells sequentially without spending two additional Actions. Quicken itself is the rank5enabling cast,not one of the two rank≤3children. Before committing Quicken choose both child IDs,modes and actual casting-class profiles from real repertoire; they may be the same ID if normally legal. Each child must have an actual casting time of one Action,not a Reaction,BA,long ritual,item activation or class technique. It retains its own actual targets/range,components,RP/material/additional costs,Dissonance/Refrain,concentration and cast-interruption window. The enabling spell pays its own price/beginning hooks first; if countered,it produces no window or child costs. If it survives,attempt child one normally at that checkpoint,choosing its real legal targets. Commit its own costs/cadence/concentration before its own Counterspell opportunity,then finish its actual resolution and dependent responses. Then recheck the caster's state,spell access,actual next price/resources and legal targets for child two,whose targets may be chosen using ordinary information now available. An illegal or unaffordable child cannot be replaced by a different undeclared spell or saved for later; that opportunity is lost without charging an uncommitted child,while prior paid costs remain. A miss,successful save or countered first child does not by itself remove a still-legal second opportunity. Incapacity,death,loss of a required component/access or another genuine restriction can. No unrelated movement,BA,Action or delay is inserted between the two child casts; their own movement/effects and required interruptions still resolve. Actual concentration replacement happens independently for each child; two concentration spells do not become simultaneous unless a separate real source already permits it. This explicitly overrides ordinary one-Action casting economy only for the two described child casts; any actual separate source-wide prohibitions or per-rest/per-round activation limits still apply. It grants no extra turn,second Action for attacks/items,third child,post-turn bank or free RP. The window closes after the second opportunity or current turn ending. Copies/replays of the enabling payload cannot create another such child-cast window without a separately explicit reviewed source permission; child casts cannot select Quicken because its actual rank5is outside the cap. Cost waivers do not lower rank. Each child is a real cast for permitted source hooks,and each shares actual chronological cast history with nested Counterspells. Resuming a child after an interruption does not pay/update cadence a second time. No concentration or ongoing grant remains after the window.

TC124-QC-01 DIRECTOR SELECTION. The Self-only recipient and finite two-child contained casting window are explicit NEW choices rather than an allied60ft grant. The ordinary price remains10RP. Child selected-class ranks must actually be0..3, with real known/prepared one-Action ordinary spells. Lock both child spell identities, modes, selected classes and intended use of source-owned optional modifications at the enabling commitment; individual legal recipients/area points are selected at each child's own commitment, before its counter window, never after its outcomes. No payable price or target is fabricated to fill an unavailable child.
Use actual Wizard protected first-distinct prepared-family accounting. With fresh prepared Wizard9, Quicken then Fireball then Fireball pays32-10-5-5=12RP, base0+0+1 and Refrain0+0+1 => totalDissonance2. This explicitly corrects the preserved historical D4 example. A nested caster Counterspell is a genuine later cast in that same history: resuming the child does not restore old lastSpell or rewrite the nested history. All native type/save/area/self-exclusion and life consequences remain.
No universal once-per-turn limit is added. A genuinely acquired extra FULL Action whose source allows ordinary Action spellcasting can pay another Quicken only within that source's restrictions; the contained child opportunities are not fresh transferable full Actions. Preserve the parent action-ancestry flag on both children. In particular no extra-Action-origin Haste or other child may generate an extra Action where the inherited source forbids that chain. Copies/replays/secondary echoes of Quicken cannot create this window without their own expressly authorized source. Ordinary Ready does not extend the window past the caster's actual current turn: an off-turn release has no child window, whereas a legal same-own-turn release has the existing turn remainder only. Nothing here modifies COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 or grants an additional interrupt Reaction.

KEEP setting a trigger for another spell to activate automatically. NEW create one empty Contingency frame attached to a willing perceived creature within60feet/line of effect,including self. The wrapper costs its actual13RP/Action/components and has its own ordinary counter window. On successful formation it lasts24elapsed hours without concentration;the caster must load it within60elapsed seconds or it expires empty. One frame per originating caster,including empty/loaded frames;successful new formation replaces the old frame and any stored payload without a refund. The bound creature cannot be changed later. This is an explicitly new operational duration in place of Instantaneous metadata.

LOAD:while within60feet/line of effect to the bound creature,the original caster actually casts one separately acquired,fully specified rank0through5ordinary spell with casting time one Action. Pay that spell's actual action,components,consumed materials,RP/cadence and cast-start hooks once. Its actual current costs are not included in the wrapper's13RP. It must lawfully be able to target the bound creature alone or place its entire declared area center/origin on that creature's position;Self-only payloads require the bound creature to be the original caster. At loading,satisfy real source range/touch/target restrictions. Declare all modes,selections and permitted target policy then. No additional selected creature/object outside the eventual area may be named later. A spell that requires unresolved player choices or missing source mechanics cannot be made complete through storage.

NEW storage exception:after the real paid payload cast survives its normal Counterspell window,hold its unresolved main effect in this frame rather than resolving it now. This is one original spell,not a copied free cast. Preparation commits any normal concentration transition and ends the caster's previous concentration when required,even though no ongoing payload concentration is maintained during storage. All costs remain spent. A loading attempt consumes the frame's one loading opportunity;countering or otherwise negating that payload ends the frame rather than leaving an endlessly refillable empty slot. Payload duration starts only on actual release;original generating rank/source/modes and legitimate snapshots remain recorded. Current-at-resolution quantities still use their real source rules when release occurs.

TRIGGER:at wrapper creation specify one future observable event,or at most three simple predicates with fixed AND/OR logic. The frame has only ordinary visual/hearing observation within30feet of its bound creature,using real cover and environmental visibility,and the explicitly NEW ability to read that bound body's own actual HP0/positive-damage/Unconscious transitions. It can also use one fixed elapsed deadline inside its24hours. It cannot inspect intent,alignment,secret membership,unseen inventory,another creature's private resources,spell rank or unchosen future behavior. A spoken passphrase,visible creature entering a declared local radius,or actual bound-body transition can qualify;the sensor is a trigger evaluator,not an intelligence or information feed to the caster. Hidden ineligible trigger facts do not become true by naming them.

Arm only after successful loading. A prior event is not replayed,and an already-true state predicate must genuinely become false then true after arming unless the trigger is a future explicit deadline. A genuine crossing can be caused by the bound creature moving,under ordinary actual geometry. On the first qualifying event,mark the frame and payload spent before queuing release. Finish the current indivisible damage/healing/cast/command event,including its ordinary survival/death consequences;then release in fixed application/identity order. It cannot interrupt that event retroactively or prevent InstantDeath after it already occurred. NEW at most one automatic Contingency release per originating caster per numbered round;outside initiative,no second release until6elapsed seconds after that caster's actual previous release. Preserve that actual history through initiative transitions rather than resetting it. A qualifying trigger while the applicable limit is spent consumes this one-shot frame without a later banked release.

RELEASE:the real unresolved spell originates at the bound creature's current position,an explicit NEW stored-origin permission. Its named target is that same creature,or its predeclared area center/origin is that position;use actual current area geometry and line of effect from there. No remote new target choice or borrowed senses occurs. Apply the spell's real current target eligibility,defenses,save/attack and actual outcome rules. A dead/removed/otherwise illegal target gives a spent failed release,not retargeting or refund. Self-only mechanics still belong only to their legal original caster. The automatic release replaces the payload's ordinary Action commitment because that Action was already paid at loading;it supplies no additional ordinary Action/Bonus Action/Reaction or repeated cast-start/Dissonance event. Bound-creature unconsciousness does not itself prevent an otherwise valid nonconcentration payload.

If the payload requires concentration,the original caster must at release be conscious,able to concentrate,and within60feet/line of effect of the bound creature. Begin that concentration and end any then-current incompatible concentration immediately before resolution;failure of this requirement consumes the release without effect. A stored nonconcentration payload can release while its living original caster is elsewhere/unconscious,subject to all real frame/target protections. Original caster death ends the frame;it cannot create a posthumous second source/controller. The bound creature's death alone is a genuine event,not permission for an ineligible healing spell to resurrect it. A successful outcome triggers only the real original spell's eligible resolution hooks once.

Release is not a new spell cast and opens no second ordinary Counterspell window;countering at loading,dispelling/suppressing the frame before release,and actual defenses remain meaningful. A prophecy can report the real pending release without reopening an old counter window. Remove an actual still-loaded rank-six frame and its unresolved stored payload ends;no resource is recovered. Suppression blocks sensing and release while the original deadlines continue. The bound body and original caster must remain on the same actually established plane for the frame to sense/release;an unknown or different relation makes it inactive without a diagnostic. This creates no cross-plane communication or new cosmological topology. Missed transient events are lost;an already-true state on return is not a fresh crossing. A fixed deadline missed during suppression/inactivity expires the frame's chance rather than firing late. A genuine later qualifying event can trigger a still-armed unspent frame within the original lifetime.

No payload may create/load another Contingency or another deferred automatic-cast store,or copy/replay an already stored spell. For multiple preexisting frames whose releases cause later genuine events,process each actual frame at most once;the dispatch set is the finite set armed before the originating external event,so a newly created frame cannot join that same chain. Every frame retains its real owner/round cap. This finite queue rule is expressly proposed,not proof of a completed scheduler. No item gem,unpriced component,free daily refill,new repertoire or hidden-fact oracle is imported from another game.

Reviewed Glyph of Warding already has a complete,distinct procedure:one writable noncreature surface,one-minute concentration,one subsequent bodily touch or actually visible entry trigger,and one finite alarm/repulsion/ward payload included in its ordinary casting cost. It explicitly does not store another spell or create a permanent trap. Its retained moving-anchor history,ordinary observation,consume-before-payload and missed-suppression-event rules inform this comparison;they do not authorize Contingency's new24-hour storage,body-state sensing,remote stored origin or separately paid loading exception. If a legal Glyph is selected as the payload under the current target policy,it still needs its actual surface target;this creature/area-only Contingency policy does not supply one,so that particular loading is ineligible. Neither card gains the other card's access or components.

TC124-CT-01 DIRECTOR COMPLETION. The 24-hour frame,60-second loading interval, rank0..5 ordinary payload whitelist by declared capability (not an invented spell), bound-body sensors, displaced concentration at load, unloaded concentration storage, automatic bound-origin release and finite dispatch policy above are all expressly selected NEW local authoring. They do not change Glyph, ordinary Ready, class Echo or copied-feat Ready.
At frame commitment freeze bound identity and the complete event/deadline/predicate declaration. At payload commitment freeze actual modes, whole material/target/body/state plan, genuine current eligibility, any expressly load-time costs/snapshots, and all optional choices. This includes the full Grave Gift target/HP-cost record. Reserve the frame's single load attempt atomically with the legal payload commitment; an invalid not-yet-committed declaration does not debit or fabricate eligibility. A payload counter or real paid failure ends that frame. The original load deadline is formation+60 and frame expiry formation+86400; equality expires before load/release. A fixed trigger deadline is strictly inside that expiry and genuinely future when armed.
Current applied Grave Gift is a legal rank5 Action example only when the other willing living ally is already0HP Dying/Stable at LOAD, perceived in60ft/LoE and donor has>=2 normalHP. Pay10baseRP and floor(donor currentHP/2) then. Healthy preload is illegal. The paid donor cost remains fixed at later release. Revalidate that same recipient then: direct restoration reaches its current effective maximum (not the ordinary Critical heal ceiling), while broad cannot-regain-HP and the exact False Life recipient gate retain their real scope. Independently legal stabilization follows Grave Gift even when its HP assignment is blocked. No ordinary-healing event, donor refund or postmortem rescue is added. A prior HP0 crossing cannot arm retroactively. To show a later crossing, the case must contain genuine intervening positive recovery and a new positive-to-zero event; the chosen main example instead uses an explicit future deadline and labels that altered historical premise.
A dispatch epoch snapshots the finite set of already-armed frame IDs BEFORE the complete originating external event begins. A frame created/loaded in that event cannot join that epoch. Capture actual qualifying event records after the event completes, including all inherent damage/sharing/life/death and native source consequences. Original event and frame IDs key durable claims. Consume each qualifying frame/payload before its attempt. Revalidate owner alive, exact same-plane relation, target and current suppression before releasing.
